ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Greentide
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
GREENTIDE_STANDALONE_MOD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-11, on the churnmud card, verbatim: "This is a really cool mechanic and suggests making the Biome Greentide its own RimMandrake level mod too."). A furiously humid, ground-hugging jungle biome and its own hazard kit, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Greentide instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the four v1 mechanics the owner ruled MUST ship together, not deferred (the source design kit's "Owner rulings" section):
1. Churnmud (M8, NO EXEMPTION ruling): RM_GreentideChurnmud is a natural high-pathCost mire terrain. RM_MapComponent_TerrainMire escalates an RM_Mired hediff (slowed, then stuck) on anyone standing on it; RM_MapComponent_MudSwallow buries loose items left there long enough — a RM_DigOutBuried designation and job get them back, nothing is destroyed. Deliberately never checks stockpile/haul-destination status: mud under a player stockpile zone swallows stored items too, exactly as ruled. 2. Toxin sealant, sourced from sap/resin (ruling confirmed): RM_SapResin is rendered from wood at a machining table; RM_ToxinSealant is crafted from sap/resin at the same bench; RM_ChurnmudSealed is a normal buildable floor costed in sealant that replaces churnmud with safe ground — it carries no RM_MireExtension, so sealing a cell IS the safety mechanism, no separate registry needed. 3. Seek-shade AI (deferral REJECTED — ships in v1): RM_JobGiver_SeekShade, added to the shared mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors assembly (generic — any race carrying RM_SeekShadeExtension seeks a roofed cell once ambient temperature crosses its threshold). Wired here onto Muffalo as a live, testable demonstration; Greentide's own fauna roster is a follow-on item. 4. The silence cue (deferral REJECTED — ships in v1): RM_MapComponent_SilenceCue, also in the shared assembly — a predator carrying RM_SilenceAuraExtension hunting near the player's home area ends and later restores the map's biome ambience sustainers (Find.SoundRoot.sustainerManager / AmbientSoundManager.Notify_SwitchedMap — the one route RimSage confirmed for a live sustainer, since Sustainer/AmbientSoundManager expose no partial volume-ramp API). Wired onto Warg for the same reason.
NOT in this mod (scoped out by the calling item, not deferred sub rosa): the other seven GREENTIDE_MECHANICS_1 mechanics (wet-bulb, dry-air blower, scald/ steam devils, Roil/Breaklight weather, tree-fall, Lunger, root causeways) — those depend on ALPHA_MECHANICS_KIT_1 / EXPLOSIVE_PLANT_GROWTH_1 and are a separate build. The Greatbole LANDMARK itself (the mineable ancient bole, RUT_GreatboleCore/Heartwood and its threshold-ladder events) is still one of those — it lives in mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards + the campaign's UtinniPatches, unbuilt for this mod's own biome today.
GREATBOLE_HARVEST_LADDER_1 (2026-09-25) added the fruit's own harvest economy here instead, per design/RimMandrake/exposure_gear_matrix_spec.md's own naming ruling ("Royal Rind (RM_RoyalRind stuff from RM_GreatboleFruit)" is RM_ tier, not campaign tier): RM_GreatboleFruit (the fruit), its three butchered products (RM_GreatboleFruitSteak, RM_RoyalRind, RM_GreatboleSeed), RM_Apparel_RindCoat, and RM_GreatboleGrub (the fruit's contesting purple grub — reuses this mod's own mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors dependency, no new one added). These items existed independently of the landmark that drops them, and that gap is now closed:
GREENTIDE_JUNGLE_TREE_ROSTER_1 (2026-09-26) gave this biome its own tree canopy — 14 invented, franchise-free RM_ jungle trees (RM_Greentide_TreeRoster.xml, wired directly into this BiomeDef's own <wildPlants>, replacing the rejected Plant_TreeOak/Plant_TreePoplar/ Plant_Bush) plus the franchise-free signature giant, RM_Greatbole (RM_Greatbole.xml) — the mature, fellable life stage of the same species as the campaign-tier landmark, sharing its visual family and nothing else (no shared def, no growth path; the relationship is fiction by design). Felling one is the franchise-free source for the fruit economy above that this file used to call "owed separately." RM_Greatbole drops true hardwood (RM_GreatboleHardwood, a new RM_ tier resource — deliberately NOT a reference to the campaign's RUT_Hardwood, so this mod still depends on nothing Utinni-side) via the shared, def-agnostic RM_FellableTreeExtension / RM_TreeFallUtility mechanism in mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards (an optional dependency, gated per-<li> with MayRequire, not a hard mod dependency of this mod). The roster's seven non-tree understory plants (brakkel, tumbel, sarquin, phorrik, wollick, maddrick, illurin) are a follow-on, GREENTIDE_UNDERSTORY_PLANT_ROSTER_1 — this biome's foragedFood stays RawBerries until brakkel ships to replace it.
GREENTIDE_FRENZY_DISEASE_1 (2026-09-26) authored this project's first disease, RM_Frenzy — a staged work-speed high that ends in a multi-day coma, lethal untended and survivable if tended during the coma. Disease_Flu and Disease_Malaria came out of this biome's disease list, replaced one-for-one by the ambient half of RM_Frenzy (RM_Greentide_FrenzyDisease); the deliberate half is a harvested item, RM_FrenzyDose, refined at a Drug Lab from RM_GorbelethToxin (RM_Gorbeleth's own harvest, row 14 of the tree roster). Both routes are gated by one Mod Settings toggle.
Live proof is OWED at publish time — see the item's own verify record.
